_about: The benchmark scene's counts for `bun run probe bench` (#429), which fails when one drifts more than `band` from here. Valid only on the probe page: default prefs (?defaults, #253) and P.BENCH with Follow the Ground on (#256). Milliseconds and heap are not kept: SwiftShader makes them noise. A commit that moves a count on purpose updates this file and says why in its message (docs/TESTS.md, 'Measuring performance').
